narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>One half and three sixths? They have different numbers, so they cannot be the same length.
<bookmark mark='fade'/>The numbers alone do not tell us the length of the pieces.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We must look at the wall and see where each length ends.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says different numbers cannot be the same length; the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 6 float beside the wall and fade; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>On the wall, two fractions are equal when their lengths end at the same place.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Are two fourths and three sixths the same length on the wall?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows: rows of the same whole, same end, same length; then Your turn: 2/4 and 3/6 on the wall
